label: Coerce Number
author: Conky-Studio
description: Force any input (text, category, percent, …) into a number. Non-numeric strings become Default. Bridge text sources into gauges/bars that only accept numbers.
lua_expr: (function() local s = tostring({input} or ''); local n = tonumber(s); if n ~= nil then return n end; local n2 = tonumber(s:match('([%-%d%.]+)')) ; return n2 ~= nil and n2 or ({default}) end)()
